name: applet
description: Build, run and share small stateful apps on Applet from chat, with no local environment.

interface.shortDescription: Build and share small stateful apps from chat
interface.longDescription: Describe an app and the agent builds it on Applet: a page, a tool or a small service with its own data, live at its own URL seconds after each change. Apps stay private until you choose to share them.
defaultPrompt: Build me a small app to track my team's lunch orders
